title: IAEA Internship Programme
description: A paid internship at the International Atomic Energy Agency, most commonly at its Vienna, Austria headquarters (though some placements are available at IAEA field/regional offices), open to university last-year students and recent graduates from any country worldwide. Interns receive a monthly stipend of EUR 1,450 to help cover basic subsistence costs; travel and visa costs are not covered and are the intern's own responsibility. Internships run for a minimum of three months and up to one year. Applicants must be at least 20 years old, have completed at least three years of full-time university study toward a first degree (or apply within one year of completing a bachelor's, master's, or doctoral degree), have a working knowledge of English, and have not previously participated in an IAEA internship. Two signed letters of recommendation are required with the application. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis against specific posted internship vacancies rather than one fixed annual deadline.
visaNote: This is an internship, not employment; interns are responsible for their own visa arrangements and travel costs to Austria.
